title: New Votoms Anime Films' Trailer Unveils Cast, More Staff
content:
The official website for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise , revealed the full trailer and character visual for the anime on Friday. The trailer reveals the anime's cast, as well as more staff members.

Miyuki Sawashiro plays Ash Vamps (left in visual above), a notorious and feared AT pilot called the Grey Witch. Mabuki Andou plays Maki Stauffenberg (right), an officer secretly assigned to look into Ash's past.

Other cast members include Shinichirō Miki , Yūki Kaji , Yūichi Nakamura , Satoshi Tsuruoka , Tomokazu Sugita , Kenta Miyake , Chafurin, Hōchū Ōtsuka , Daisuke Ono , Takayuki Sugō , Takahiro Sakurai , and Sumire Uesaka .

The newly announced staff members include:

• Original Character Design Concepts: Kazuchika Kise (xxxHOLiC, Made in Abyss, Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot)

• Character Design: Shingo Ogiso, Takashi Kojima, Tetsuya Nishio

• Original Mechanical Designer: Kunio Ōkawara

• Mechanical Design: Jū Ishiguchi, Wataru Inada

• Costume Design Assistance: Katsuya Terada

• Art Design: Satoshi Takabatake, Yasumitsu Suetake, Kazushige Kanehira

• Art Director: Yūshi Honjō

• Color Key Artist: Nagisa Abe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūki Kawashita

• CG Directors: Yōta Tasaki, Toshihisa Yokoshima, Jō Nakajima

• Editing: Aya Hida

• Sound Director: Kazuhiro Wakabayashi

Mamoru Oshii is directing the two films. Ryōsuke Takahashi , director and creator of the original concept for the original 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime, is supervising the film. Shinobu Tsuneki ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These , Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Kaiju No. 8 ) and Sōkō Kihei Votoms: AT Stories manga artist Yoshiro Sōno are the mechanical designers. Kenji Kawai , who has worked with Oshii in various projects including Ghost in the Shell and Patlabor 2: The Movie , is composing the music.

The 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime is an iconic entry in the so-called "real robot" subgenre of mecha pioneered by Mobile Suit Gundam , characterized by robots as mass-produced military machines (with limitations in operation akin to real-life war machines) and gritty and grounded stories about war and its bitter costs.

The original 1983 anime is set during the ebb of a century-long conflict between the two nations of the Gilgamesh Confederation and the Balarant Union. The unit that dominates the battlefield is the VOTOMS (Vertical One-man Tank for Offense & Maneuvers), a class of powerful yet extremely vulnerable mecha , known as much for their firepower as they are for the high casualty numbers of their pilots due to thin armor and lack of safety measures. The protagonist, Chirico Cuvie, is a member of an elite Gilgamesh VOTOMS unit that becomes a pawn in a vast conspiracy that brands him a traitor to Gilgamesh, and leads him to cross paths with a mysterious woman.

Section23 Films ' Maiden Japan label most recently released the original anime on Blu-ray Disc in 2019 and 2020.

The original series has inspired a number of spinoff anime, including Armored Trooper Votoms: The Last Red Shoulder , Armored Trooper Votoms: Big Battle , Armor Hunter Mellowlink , Armored Trooper Votoms: Red Shoulder Document - Roots of Treachery , Armored Trooper Votoms: Pailsen Files , Armored Trooper Votoms: The Heretic Saint , and Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again . Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again , the latest entry in the series until now, debuted in 2011.
author: ANN

title: 'Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe' Unveils Cast Members, Additional Staff, Trailer
content:
The official website of the Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms: Die Graue Hexe ) anime unveiled the cast members, additional staff, and main trailer on Friday. The anime will premiere as two movies, with the first one scheduled to open in theaters on November 20.

Cast Ash Vamps: Miyuki Sawashiro ( Hunter x Hunter (2011) ) Maki Stauffenberg: Mabuki Andou ( Seirei no Moribito ) Shinichiro Miki ( Bleach ) Yuuki Kaji ( Shingeki no Kyojin ) Yuuichi Nakamura ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) Satoshi Tsuruoka ( Fate/Zero ) Tomokazu Sugita ( Gintama ) Kenta Miyake ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Chafuurin ( Higurashi no Naku Koro ni ) Houchuu Ootsuka ( Naruto ) Daisuke Ono ( Kuroshitsuji ) Takayuki Sugou ( Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann ) Takahiro Sakurai ( Mob Psycho 100 ) Sumire Uesaka ( Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san )

Staff Original Story: Hajime Yatate ( Yoroi Shin Den Samurai Troopers ) Ryousuke Takahashi ( Soukou Kihei Votoms ) Script: Mamoru Oshii ( Ghost in the Shell , Kidou Keisatsu Patlabor ), Kei Yamamura ( Vlad Love ) Original Character Design: Kazuchika Kise ( Made in Abyss ) Character Design: Tetsuya Nishio ( Kaijuu 8-gou ), Takashi Kojima ( Kimi to, Nami ni Noretara ), Shingo Ogiso ( Arslan Senki (TV) ) Sound Director: Kazuhiro Wakabayashi ( Sen to Chihiro no Kamikakushi )

Mamoru Oshii is directing the anime at Sunrise , with Production I.G credited for production cooperation. Kenji Kawai ( Koukaku Kidoutai ) is composing the music.

The original sci-fi drama television anime aired in 52 episodes from Spring 1983 to Winter 1984. The Red Shoulder Document - Yabou no Roots ( Roots of Treachery ) prequel OVA debuted in March 1988, followed by the 12-episode Pailsen Files OVA from October 2007 to August 2008. A Pailsen Files movie adaptation premiered in Japan in January 2009, featuring a new story.

The five-episode Kakuyaku taru Itan ( Brilliantly Shining Heresy ) sequel OVA was released from March to November in 1994, followed by the six-episode Genei-hen ( Phantom Arc ) OVA from March to October in 2010 and Koei Futatabi ( Alone Again ) OVA in 2011.

The latest spin-off installments in the franchise, Case;Irvine and Votoms Finder ( Votoms Finder Armored Trooperoid ), were released in November and December in 2010.

Main Trailer

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime's New Teaser Reveals October 20 Netflix Debut
content:
The staff for the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime unveiled a new teaser trailer for the anime on Friday. The trailer announces the anime's October 20 debut date on Netflix .

Japanese Trailer:

English Trailer:

The staff describe the series:

It presents a new standalone 10-episode story from the world of Cyberpunk 2077— a raw chronicle of redemption and revenge. When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?

The casts include (Japanese/English):

• Momoka Terasawa/Valeria Rodriguez as Roman Carax

• Akari Kitō/Kimoy Lee as Talia Yang

• Kōki Uchiyama/Nazeeh Tarsha as D

• Kentarō Tone/Clancy Brown as Weak Kingsley

Rapper RICO NASTY wrote and performed "YOU CAN'T RUN FROM ME" for the anime, and it appeared in the second teaser trailer.

Kai Ikarashi (who was a storyboard artist, animation director, animator, and prop designer for the first series) is helming the new series in his directorial debut. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners producer and writer Bartosz Sztybor is again working on the series, and Ichigo Kanno (animation director and key animator on the first series) is the lead character designer. Masahiko Otsuka is returning as the scriptwriter. The new series will stream on Netflix .

The anime's opening theme song is The Cure 's 1978 song "10:15 Saturday Night," and the ending theme song is Petite Meller 's "Watson."

The first episode had a premiere screening at Anime Expo on July 3.

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , the anime series by Studio Trigger based on CD PROJEKT RED 's Cyberpunk 2077 game, debuted on Netflix in September 2022. The game is itself based on Mike Pondsmith 's Cyberpunk tabletop RPG game series.

Aniplex of America will release the series on a complete Blu-ray Disc set in North America on October 28. Anime Limited and Plaion Pictures will release the series on home video in Europe, and Sugoi Co will release the series on home video in Australia and New Zealand.

A prequel manga titled Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Madness from artist Asano ( BNA: Brand New Animal manga) and writer Bartosz Sztybor ( CD PROJEKT RED ) launched on the Comic Alive+ website in December 2024, and is getting a release in seven languages aside from Japanese. Dark Horse is releasing the series in English in print.
author: ANN

title: Sakamoto Days Season 2 Introduces Three New Characters With a Trailer
content:
SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2 TV anime revealed a new character trailer ahead of the anime’s January 2027 release date. The first season made strong numbers at Netflix , and the sequel was announced shortly after its ending. The sequel will also have a new director, with Daisuke Nakajima taking over Masaki Watanabe. Watanabe is credited as chief director. Netflix will again exclusively stream the anime worldwide. Studio TMS Entertainment will again be in charge of the animation, with Yo Moriyama returning as the character designer and Taku Kishimoto returning to handle the series composition.

The anime recently revealed an alternate version of its teaser visual , while you can watch the new character trailer below.

You can watch the previously revealed teaser trailer below.

Yuto Suzuki writes and draws the SAKAMOTO DAYS manga series. It has been serialized in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine since 2020, with a total of 28 volumes released as of August 4, 2026. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English. The series also got a live-action film adaptation , which released in Japan during the 2026 Golden Week (April 29 to May 5).

The story follows Taro Sakamoto, a legendary hitman who retired in order to marry and have a child. He now runs a store, but his past life is not that easy to get rid off. Despite looking very different as a retiree, Sakamoto will not hesitate to protect his family and take down anyone who tries to put them in danger.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix Reveals New Updates for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners S2, THE ONE PIECE, Blue Eye Samurai, Bass x Machina, and More
content:
Netflix revealed a new slate of animation updates during Anime NYC, including release dates for CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 and Blue Eye Samurai Season 2, the first key visual for THE ONE PIECE , a character trailer SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2, and more for several upcoming projects.

The announcements featured Japanese anime and other animated productions influenced by anime, with the latest updates including:

Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Gets October 2026 Release Date

CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 will officially premiere on Netflix on October 20, 2026, with a new teaser trailer and images revealed.

The sequel is being produced as a new standalone 10-episode story set in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , rather than a direct continuation of David Martinez’s story from the original series. Netflix describes the new story as one centered on redemption and revenge in Night City.

The original Cyberpunk: Edgerunners premiered in 2022 with 10 episodes and was produced by TRIGGER in collaboration with CD PROJEKT RED.

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Premieres in January 2027, Conclusion Set for 2028

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 will release in January 2027, with Netflix releasing a new teaser and images from the upcoming season. The company also announced that production is underway on what it describes as the series’ “epic conclusion,” scheduled for 2028.

THE ONE PIECE Reveals New Key Art

Netflix revealed new key art for THE ONE PIECE , the upcoming anime adaptation of Eiichiro Oda’s manga.

The series is being animated by WIT Studio and will adapt the story from the beginning, starting with the East Blue Saga. The project was originally announced in December 2023 and is separate from Toei Animation’s ongoing ONE PIECE TV anime.

Netflix previously released the first teaser trailer during the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in June.

LEGO ONE PIECE Gets Official Trailer

The two-part LEGO ONE PIECE animated special received its official trailer ahead of its September 29, 2026 Netflix premiere.

The special follows Usopp as he recounts the Straw Hat Pirates’ adventures across the East Blue and into the Grand Line to Chopper. Members of Netflix’s live-action ONE PIECE cast reprise their characters as part of the voice cast, including Iñaki Godoy as Luffy, Mackenyu as Zoro, Emily Rudd as Nami, Jacob Romero as Usopp and Taz Skylar as Sanji.

Atomic Cartoons is producing the project in collaboration with Shueisha and The LEGO Group.

FOOL NIGHT Reveals New Trailer and English Dub Cast

The upcoming Fool Night anime received a new teaser trailer and featurette, while Adam McArthur and Olivia Liang were announced for its English dub.

The anime adapts Kasumi Yasuda’s manga and marks the first animation production collaboration between SUNRISE and SHAFT. Atsushi Yukawa is directing, with Jin Tanaka handling series composition and Robert Sato designing the characters. Tatsuya Kato is composing the music.

The story takes place in a future where Earth is trapped beneath thick clouds and faces a severe oxygen shortage. Humanity has developed “Transfloration,” a process that transforms people approaching death into plants. Toshiro Kamiya, a young man living in poverty, eventually faces the decision of whether to undergo the procedure himself.

Koki Uchiyama and Minako Kotobuki are among the previously confirmed Japanese voice cast members.

SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2 Gets New Character Trailer

SAKAMOTO DAYS Season 2 received a new character trailer as Netflix continues to promote the anime’s next chapter. The second season was officially announced in December 2025.

The anime is based on Yuto Suzuki’s manga, which began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump in 2020.

Bass X Machina Debuts Official Teaser

Netflix also released the official teaser trailer and new images for Bass X Machina , an adult animated series created by LeSean Thomas, with Brian Tyree Henry serving as an executive producer and voicing the lead character.

The series is inspired by the life of historical lawman Bass Reeves but places its story in a steampunk Western setting populated by mechanical and supernatural threats. Its protagonist is a father forced to act as judge, jury and executioner while attempting to protect his family.

Netflix previously presented Bass X Machina alongside its animation lineup at Annecy 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Fool Night Anime by SHAFT and SUNRISE Reveals November 26 Premiere, New Trailer, English Voice Cast
content:
FOOL NIGHT anime adaptation by studios SHAFT and SUNRISE revealed a new trailer and additional voice cast members, as well as a November 26 premiere. This is the first-ever joint project between the two studios, and it was previously confirmed for a 2026 release exclusive to Netflix. Adam McArthur and Olivia Liang were announced for its English dub. Atsuyuki Yukawa will direct, with the anime being his directorial debut. The anime will feature character designs by Robert Sato, with Jin Tanaka in charge of the series composition. The full staff includes:

• Director: Atsushi Yukawa

• Series Composition: Jin Tanaka

• Character Design: Robert Sato

• Assistant Director: Ryo Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryo Kikuchi

• Background Director: Maki Takano (J.C.STAFF)

• Color Design: Hitoshi Hibino

• Compositing Director: Mana Ishikawa (Animocaramel),Chiaki Tokuda (TERAEFFECT),Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Director: Naoki Yamamoto,Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editorial Office)

• Sound Director: Yota Tsuruoka

• Music: Tatsuya Kato

• Animation Production: SUNRISE×SHAFT

Three additional members were added to the Japanese voice cast, which now consists of:

• Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya

• Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai

• Aya Endo as Saeko Kanaeno (NEW)

• Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka (NEW)

• Kiyomitsu Mizuchi as Jin Hiragishi (NEW)

You can also watch the English dub version of the trailer below.

A special video featuring an interview with the creators was also released.

The main voice cast includes:

• Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya

• Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai

The two characters were previously also featured in the teaser visual:

Fool Night is a Japanese seinen manga written and illustrated by Kasumi Yasuda. The series began serialization in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020 and has released 13 volumes so far. It is also available in English through VIZ Media in North America and Shogakukan Asia in Southeast Asia.

Official introduction:

Hurry up and turn me into a beautiful flower. Transfloration — a technology that implants seeds into the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants. It is the desperate measure humanity has chosen to ensure its survival. In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky, trapping Earth in constant winter and night, most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away. Facing a serious oxygen shortage, humanity has built a society that relies on the meager amount of oxygen provided by Transfloration. A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope. Living… there isn’t a single thing fun about it. In this dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of the “Spiriflor” — the plants that humans transform into. Should he continue living as a human being, or cast off his suffering and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Keeps Doing One Thing Better Than Solo Leveling
content:
Since the start of the Summer season, Crunchyroll has been streaming an anime that has been dubbed an anime like Solo Leveling due to its similar appearance and premise. As new episodes of Tomb Raider King continue to be released, the anime has proven itself to be a worthy replacement for Solo Leveling in its absence, one that fans of the original will no doubt appreciate if they love Solo Leveling . While Tomb Raider King doesn’t have the same charm as Solo Leveling and its execution is not as precise, the anime has been building its own narrative. Although Tomb Raider King essentially inherits Solo Leveling ‘s foundation, particularly its power system centered around leveling up, the anime has also established its own identity.

In Solo Leveling , the main protagonist’s journey begins with the goal of achieving greater power and wealth, and when Jinwoo gets the opportunity, he continues working toward those goals. In the process, Jinwoo also becomes ruthless due to the actions of other humans. While it takes Jinwoo time to mature, what Tomb Raider King does better is feature an older protagonist , Seo Jooheon, whose second opportunity sends him 15 years into the past, where he begins plotting his revenge against those who wronged him. Now, the latest episode reveals that this revenge trope, which makes the journey more personal, also applies to other characters, essentially forming a group of characters with the same revenge motive and giving greater meaning to their stories.

Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Continues to Make Its Revenge Trope Its Driving Force

The revenge trope in Tomb Raider King helps justify Jooheon’s extreme steps to take down his enemies, including killing some of them, from the very beginning, something that took Solo Leveling much longer to establish . Yet, Jooheon’s actions feel more compelling than Jinwoo’s because his pure instincts establish him as a ruthless protagonist driven by revenge, without trying to appear cool at all, unlike Jinwoo, who gradually becomes more of a celebrity after gaining his powers. Now, Tomb Raider King takes this revenge-driven foundation even further by introducing another character, Yoo Jaeha.

After his fight with Kwon and breaking multiple relics, Jooheon seeks Jaeha’s help, remembering him from the future as someone capable of restoring relics even when they are destroyed at their cores. However, Jaeha wasn’t simply going to form an alliance with him, and Jooheon earned his trust by becoming the person who helped him pursue his own revenge as well. This makes it clear that Tomb Raider King ‘s main driving force isn’t solving the mysteries behind the tombs’ appearance or having its protagonist emerge as a savior. Instead, Jooheon is purely driven by revenge and seeks the help of others who find themselves in similar situations.

This helps show that the anime, which fans have been comparing to Solo Leveling because of its similar premise and main character’s appearance, is actually very different, as its new episodes continue to highlight. With this notion, Tomb Raider King , currently streaming on Crunchyroll, continues to emerge as better than Solo Leveling in at least one way, and it seems this aspect will continue to help Tomb Raider King establish its own identity and potentially emerge as its own franchise in the anime industry.

title: Fool Night Anime's Teaser Reveals More Cast, November 26 Worldwide Netflix Debut
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled a new teaser trailer for the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga on Friday. The teaser revealed more cast and the November 26 worldwide Netflix debut date for the anime. Netflix will debut the entire series on November 26.

Netflix first announced the news at Anime NYC on Thursday.

Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka

Aya Endō as Saeko Kanaeno

Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi

Previously announced cast members include:

Atsuyuki Yukawa ( Suzume unit director) is directing the anime at Sunrise and SHAFT . Jin Tanaka ( Oshi no Ko ) is writing the script. Robert Satō is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katō ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Ryō Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryō Kikuchi

• Art Director: Maki Takano (J.C. Staff)

• Color Design: Jin Hibino

• Director of Photography: Mana Ishikawa (animocaramel), Chiaki Tokuda (Tera Effect), Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Directors: Naoki Yamamoto, Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editing Room)

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.

Yasuda launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on June 30.

The manga ranked #12 in the male reader list of the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

title: THE ONE PIECE Remake by WIT Studio Reveals First Key Visual
content:
THE ONE PIECE anime remake by WIT Studio has revealed its first key visual ahead of its February 2027 release date. The anime previously confirmed that Mayumi Tanaka will reprise the role of Luffy in the new anime, teasing it with a teaser trailer . The anime is a collaboration with Netflix, which is set to release all 7 episodes at once in February next year. They previously revealed the main staff members , including Masashi Koizuka as director. The first season will cover approximately 50 chapters of the original story, showing up until Luffy’s meeting with Sanji at the Baratie sea restaurant.

The new remake project is described as:

Produced by WIT Studio, THE ONE PIECE is a brand new anime adaptation starting from the original manga’s East Blue saga. Separate from the TV anime series that has charged full speed ahead over the course of more than 25 years, this series taps into the expressive potential of modern technology to offer a familiar yet fresh take on the adventures of Luffy. The rare footage of character design sheets and image boards showcased in this video provides a glimpse into the world of this new anime.

The new key visual is based on the manga’s very first color spread, and you can check both out below.

The visual is based on the color spread from the manga’s Chapter 1.

You can watch the trailer for the anime below.

You can also watch the Japanese version of the trailer, which features Mayumi Tanaka as Luffy:

ONE PIECE Remake Anime by WIT Studio Staff:

• Director: Masashi Koizuka (Attack on Titan)

• Assistant Director: Hideaki Abe (JUJUTSU KAISEN)

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Kyoji Asano (Attack on TItan, SPY x FAMILY), Takatoshi Honda (In/Spectre, The First Slam Dunk)

• Series Composition: Taku Kishimoto (Ranking of Kings, Haikyu!!)

• Prop Design: Eri Taguchi

• Action Animator: Shuhei Fukuda, Ken Imaizumi

• Art Director: Tomonori Kuroda

• Creature Design / Concept Art: Yasuhiro Kajino

• Animation Studio: WIT Studio

In a previous interview with Real Sound, president of WIT Studio and Production I.G said that they are aware 1000+ episodes are a lot, as well as that younger audiences accustomed to modern anime might find the 25-year-old episodes difficult to watch due to the 4:3 analog format. They see the remake working together with the manga, original anime, and live-action versions of ONE PIECE to expand its reach. Toei Animation has encouraged them to give it their all while they continue with the latest episodes.

Netflix describes the project as recreation of the ONE PIECE manga, starting from the East Blue arc. ONE PIECE by Eiichiro Oda first began serialization in July 1997, and the series exceeded 500 million circulating copies in August 2022. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English, while Crunchyroll streams the anime.

ONE PIECE also has Season 3 of the live-action THE BATTLE OF ALABASTA releasing in 2027 and a new LEGO special animation project releasing on September 29 coming to Netflix.
